subject: french
title: Conditional and Hypothesis
welcome_lead: The conditional expresses possibility and politeness. Si clauses build hypothetical scenarios.
final_note: What if? — in French, that is the conditional.

concepts.def: Conditional mood — expresses hypothesis or politeness.

walkthroughs.body_html: Take future stem + imparfait endings: je parlerais, tu parlerais, il parlerait, nous parlerions, vous parleriez, ils parleraient.
Si j'avais le temps, je voyagerais (imparfait + conditionnel). Si j'avais eu le temps, j'aurais voyage (plus-que-parfait + conditionnel passe).

mcqs.q: What tense follows 'depuis' for ongoing situations in French?
options: Present tense (J'habite ici DEPUIS 5 ans - I have lived here for 5 years).
Past tense (because it is translated as 'have lived' in English).

mcqs.q: When does the past participle agree with avoir verbs?
options: When the direct object comes BEFORE the verb (la pomme que j'ai mangée).
